approved_scope.title: Specify the group mailbox, membership wrap, and one message note
approved_scope.description: Specify the group mailbox, membership wrap, and one message note
acceptance_criteria: PROTOCOL.md section 5.8 specifies 0x06 and 0x07. A 0x06 note uses the 78-byte hybrid header and carries a 101-byte membership record on an established hybrid session. A 0x07 note is 54 bytes of header plus ciphertext, paid to the mailbox. The group key wrap is PQ level 3. Everyday 0x01 is not a legal wrap. Parity is not claimed until the six-library LocalNet run in section 5.8.4.
